title: Remove Falsy Values
prompt: A feed cleanup step receives a list with placeholder values mixed in. Write a function that returns a new array with all JavaScript falsy values removed.

explanation.beginner:
Example: removeFalsyValues([0,1,false,true,"","hi",null]) produces [1,true,"hi"]. The result must follow this precise rule: A feed cleanup step receives a list with placeholder values mixed in. Write a function that returns a new array with all JavaScript falsy values removed. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “keeps truthy objects and arrays”: input [[[],{},"ok"]] produces [[],{},"ok"]. Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
